brief.ask: Create the brand family for Lumenfold, the office suite in this monorepo: the Lumenfold master brand and product icons for Lumenfold Docs, Sheets and Sign.
brief.owner: Owner preferences: privacy-first and European, calm and precise. The three product icons must clearly belong to one family and still be told apart at small sizes. Web apps only.

claim.notes: Üç yönden ikisi sketch review'da elendi; kalan crease iki turda da kapıyı geçemedi (ort. 6,62, distinctiveness ve memorability 5), bu yüzden finalize, export, install-assets ve galeri çalıştırılmadı.

concepts.title: Lit Crease
readsAs: letter L with a diagonal slash
boot or flag with a gold wedge
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 an L with a detached amber foot, slightly a boot/slanted parallelogram; s2 an L with a corner triangle, set-square; s3 an open book / two panels; s4 an L with a stray block, or an i/L glitch. s1 is the only one with a hook (the mitre cut and lit foot) and the L initial that survives 16 px; s2 is a set square and s3 a book (struck); s4 is too bland. Keep s1 master; fix: make the mitre gap and foot angle match exactly so the foot reads as the stem's own fold, thicken the gap for 16 px, and stop the foot reading as a shoe; the docs/sheets/sign members must share the same cut angle, since sheets and sign currently drift. Risk: plain L monogram, so distinctiveness rests on the cut.

concepts.title: Stepped Strip
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s4 two floating shards, a caret or broken stick; at 16 px two specks, no hook; s5 a digit 9/S or a snail/curl with a brass blob (cliché trio), sign member reads as a comma-blob. The fold-with-lit-underside idea in s4 is sound but is crease's lit foot by another route and the gap kills the mark. Different move: keep one continuous solid strip with a single mitre and a lit face, heavier weight, no detached pieces.

concepts.title: Light Slit
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s5 a clipped dark tile with two brass bars (circuit chip / bandage; sheets and sign members collapse to generic diagonal stripes); s6 a dark quarter-disc with brass ticks (pie wedge, protractor, fan). s5 docs member (clipped corner with lit slit) is just crease's mitre L with a lit foot; s6 is the pie wedge cliché and is muddy at 16 px. Different move: drop the plate, make one cut-and-lit gesture that crease does not own, or merge into crease.
